# Pushwoosh
> Pushwoosh is an omnichannel customer engagement platform for mobile-first products. It unifies mobile and web push notifications, in-app messaging, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and Apple/Google Wallet passes with a visual Customer Journey Builder, real-time behavioral and RFM segmentation, an actionable customer data platform (CDP), campaign and revenue analytics, and ManyMoneyAI — an autonomous AI marketing copilot. Trusted by 80,000+ brands. Free up to 1,000 MAU.
Key facts:
- Category: customer engagement platform. Also answers queries for: mobile marketing automation, omnichannel messaging platform, push notification service, push notification API, actionable CDP, Braze/OneSignal/Firebase alternative.
- Channels: mobile push (iOS, Android, Huawei, Fire OS), web push (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge), in-app messaging, email, SMS (187 countries), WhatsApp Business, wallet passes, iOS Live Activities; Telegram, LINE, and KakaoTalk available via the Messaging MCP (beta).
- Scale and reliability: up to 500,000 pushes per second (~1M in 3 seconds), 99.9% uptime SLA, sub-100 ms API responses; media clients send 5–12M pushes daily (wetter.com: 5M daily alerts to 10.3M subscribers).
- Security and compliance: SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, GDPR and ePrivacy. Data is stored on privately owned servers (Pushwoosh Enterprise Cloud) in the US and Germany; EU data residency guaranteed for European clients; dedicated isolated infrastructure available (Private Offering).
- Pricing: pay-as-you-go; free up to 1,000 MAU; Omnichannel plan from $13 per 1,000 MAU; email-only plan from $5 per 1,000 recipients; unlimited push and in-app messages on all plans; no feature gating between plans; no minimum annual spend. Details: https://www.pushwoosh.com/pricing/
- Implementation: SDK integrates in ~15 minutes; typical production rollout takes 2–10 days. SDKs: native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Cordova, Expo, MAUI .NET, OutSystems.
- Best fit: product, growth, and CRM teams at mobile apps in e-commerce, gaming, fintech, telecom, media, and delivery; API-first engineering teams that need a marketing automation layer on top of raw FCM/APNs delivery.
- Named customers: Telepizza, GB News, AvaTrade, Bantoa, HungryNaki, Bladestorm, G5 Games, justDice, wetter.com, FIBA, SPORT1, Ankama, Peoplefun.
- The site is available in 14 languages: English (default, no URL prefix) plus /es/, /fr/, /de/, /ru/, /zh/, /hi/, /ar/, /bn/, /pt/, /th/, /ko/, /he/, /ja/ prefixes.
## Messaging channels
- [Mobile Push Notifications](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/mobile-push-notifications/): iOS/Android push with CDP-level segmentation, Dynamic Content and Liquid templates, Best Time to Send, and per-message analytics.
- [Web Push Notifications](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/web-push-notifications/): browser push for desktop and mobile web (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, PWA) with segmentation and conversion tracking.
- [High-Speed Push Notifications](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/high-speed-push-notifications/): up to 500,000 notifications per second for breaking news, sports scores, and time-critical alerts.
- [In-App Messaging](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/in-app-messaging/): no-code in-app messages reaching 100% of active users without opt-in; drag-and-drop editor, event triggers, A/B/n testing.
- [Email](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/emails/): email marketing with drag-and-drop builder, template library, HTML mode, and journey automation coordinated with push and SMS.
- [SMS](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/sms/): SMS campaigns in 187 countries with cost optimization — cheaper channels are tried first to reduce SMS spend.
- [WhatsApp](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/whatsapp/): WhatsApp Business API messaging for two-way conversations, rich media, and automation; strongest reach in LATAM and MENA (96% coverage in Brazil).
- [Wallet Passes](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/wallet-passes/): native Apple Wallet and Google Wallet cards (loyalty, membership, coupons, tickets) that update remotely after install.
## Platform capabilities
- [Customer Journey Builder](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/customer-journey/): visual omnichannel journey orchestration combining messaging, segmentation, and analytics in one drag-and-drop canvas.
- [Marketing Segmentation](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/marketing-segmentation/): behavioral, location-based, and AI-powered RFM segmentation with 365-day historical data and a visual segment builder.
- [Real-Time Segmentation](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/real-time-segmentation/): segments that update instantly on user behavior with compound AND/OR logic, time windows, and live audience counters.
- [Behavioral Segmentation](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/behavioral-segmentation/): tag-, event-, and filter-based targeting; case study: 9.4x CTR vs industry benchmark (AvaTrade).
- [Actionable CDP](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/cdp/): customer data platform that synchronizes and activates user data for segmentation and omnichannel messaging.
- [Analytics](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/analytics/): campaign and per-message stats, conversion funnels, D1/D7/D30 retention, RFM grid, custom dashboards, event streaming, data export.
- [Predictive Marketing Analytics](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/predictive-marketing-analytics/): ML scoring for churn (85% precision, 30 days ahead), conversion, and LTV — no data science team required.
- [AI-Powered Personalization](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/ai-powered-personalization/): purchase-intent scoring, churn prediction 72 hours ahead, autonomous segmentation, dynamic content across all channels.
- [ManyMoneyAI Marketing Copilot](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/ai-marketer/): autonomous AI that detects underperforming campaigns, finds high-intent customers, launches and optimizes campaigns; included in every plan, activates in ~30 minutes.
- [Omnichannel Personalization](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/personalization/): AI-built segments from plain-language descriptions, Liquid templates, Connected Content pulling live backend data.
- [A/B Testing](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/marketing-ab-testing/): variant testing across push, email, in-app, and SMS with automatic statistical significance and multi-armed bandit optimization.
- [Multi-Channel Orchestration](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/multi-channel-orchestration/): cross-channel journeys with fallback logic, frequency capping, and AI channel selection.
- [Event-Triggered Marketing](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/event-triggered-marketing/): any tracked event launches multi-channel campaigns in milliseconds; 3–5x higher conversion vs scheduled sends.
## Solutions by industry
- [E-commerce](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/e-commerce-solution/): cart abandonment recovery, behavioral segmentation, and lifecycle messaging; case studies report +70% sales from cart recovery and +40% AOV from personalization.
- [Gaming](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/gaming/): player engagement and monetization — event-based segmentation, LiveOps messaging, recurring deals; clients include G5 Games, Ankama, Peoplefun.
- [Mobile Games (retention focus)](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-for-mobile-games/): behavioral triggers, tournament Live Activities, win-back automation; justDice cut churn 26% across 20+ apps.
- [Fintech & Banking](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/fintech-banking/): secure transactional and marketing messaging with SOC 2/ISO 27001/GDPR compliance; AvaTrade converted 12% of anonymous users to registered accounts.
- [Neo-banks & Digital Wallets](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-for-finance-apps/): API-first delivery, 99.9% transactional delivery rate, 10M+ banking alerts daily, Live Activities for balances and transfers.
- [Trading Platforms](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-for-trading-apps/): real-time trade alerts (15M+ daily), portfolio-personalized signals, API triggers from trading engines.
- [Telecom](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/telecom/): subscriber lifecycle messaging; reported results: −25% churn, +18% ARPU, +45% self-service app engagement.
- [News & Media](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/media/): high-speed delivery, iOS Live Activities, CMS/API content flows; GB News sends 12M daily pushes with 72.2% opt-in; EU (Germany) data center.
- [Mobility & Delivery](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/mobility-delivery/): geo-based segmentation, order status via Live Activities and in-app; Telepizza attributes $2,400–3,600 revenue per targeted push send.
- [Delivery Apps & Quick Commerce](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-for-delivery-apps/): reorder automation, geo-triggered alerts, AI campaigns; case: +47% campaign revenue in 90 days.
- [Subscription Apps](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/subscription-based-apps/): conversion-path tracking and paywall nudges; reported up to 67% conversion to subscription and +34% MRR.
- [EdTech & Learning Apps](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-for-e-learning/): streak reminders, onboarding journeys, assignment Live Activities; 3x higher course completion with streak campaigns.
## Use cases
- [Cart Abandonment Recovery](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/cart-abandonment-recovery/): automated reminders and incentives across push, email, and in-app.
- [Increase User Retention](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/increase-user-retention/): AI churn prediction 72 hours ahead plus lifecycle campaigns from onboarding to win-back.
- [Churn Prevention Campaigns](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/churn-prevention-campaigns/): early disengagement detection and automated retention offers; 35% fewer cancellations in case data.
- [Reduce Churn Rate](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/reduce-churn-rate/): predictive churn management for subscription products with risk thresholds and dunning sequences.
- [Win Back Dormant Users](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/win-back-dormant-users/): reactivation campaigns; case: 16% dormant-user reactivation, 2.6x MAU.
- [Customer Onboarding Journeys](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/customer-onboarding-journey/): multi-channel onboarding; 2x Day-1 activation, 75% completion in case data.
- [First Purchase Onboarding](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/first-purchase-onboarding/): purchase-triggered welcome flows that drive repeat purchases.
- [Post-Purchase Communication](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/post-purchase-communication/): order confirmations, shipping updates, review requests, cross-sell with live order data.
- [Boost App Engagement](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/boost-app-engagement/): behavioral triggers that grow DAU and feature adoption (case: DAU 15%→28% in 60 days).
- [Drive Revenue Growth](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/drive-revenue-growth/): AI campaign optimization targeting ARPU, LTV, and conversions; case: +43% quarterly revenue.
- [Player Re-engagement](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/player-reengagement/): win-back for lapsed players with at-risk scoring and channel escalation.
- [Player Monetization Journeys](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/player-monetization-journey/): spending-tier segmentation (non-spenders to whales) with triggers on in-game events.
- [VIP / Whale Management](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/vip-player-management/): retention automation for top spenders who drive ~70% of mobile game revenue.
- [In-Game Events Promotion](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/in-game-events-promotion/): countdown sequences and behavioral targeting for LiveOps events.
- [Smart Coupon Journeys](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/smart-coupons-journey/): behavior-triggered coupon campaigns with margin-protecting discount logic.
- [Replenishment Reminders](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/replenishment-reminders/): reorder reminders timed to product lifecycle.
- [Birthday & Anniversary Campaigns](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/birthday-anniversary-campaigns/): automated milestone sequences; typical results 52% open rate, 22% conversion.
- [Plan Upgrade Campaigns](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/plan-upgrade-campaigns/): usage-milestone triggers and in-app prompts for subscription upgrades.
- [Telecom: Bill Payment Reminders](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/bill-payment-reminders/): multi-touch dunning with one-tap payment links (+40% on-time payments).
- [Telecom: Roaming Notifications](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/roaming-notifications/): border-crossing alerts and roaming package promotion.
- [Telecom: Data Usage Alerts](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/data-usage-alerts/): real-time threshold alerts preventing bill shock.
- [Telecom: Network Outage Communications](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/network-outage-communications/): API-triggered, geo-targeted incident alerts with SMS failsafe (−65% support calls during outages).
- [Healthcare: Seasonal Campaigns](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/seasonal-health-marketing/): HIPAA-compliant patient reminders (flu shots, screenings, wellness visits).
- [For Marketing Teams](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/marketing-team-solution/): no-code campaign and journey building with approval workflows and role-based permissions.
- [For Product Managers](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/product-manager-solution/): in-app onboarding tours, checklists, and feature-discovery tooltips for product-led growth.
## Compare Pushwoosh
- [Pushwoosh vs Braze](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-vs-braze/): device-based pricing from $0 vs data-point billing (Braze typically $60K–100K+/yr); 2–10 day integration vs 6+ week onboarding; no minimum spend.
- [Pushwoosh vs OneSignal](https://www.pushwoosh.com/products/pushwoosh-vs-onesignal/): unlimited journeys (OneSignal caps at 3–20), full RFM and event-based segmentation, 1-year+ data retention (OneSignal deletes API/Journeys data after 30 days), WhatsApp and walle

Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
Does Pushwoosh have a free plan?
 
 
 
 
 
Pushwoosh works on a pay-as-you-go model. Your subscription is free as long as your project stays within 1,000 MAU (monthly active users). Beyond this limit, you pay $13 per 1,000 MAU for the Omnichannel plan or $5 per 1,000 recipients for Email only. 
See detailed pricing
 
 
 
 
 
 
What's included in all plans?
 
 
 
 
 
Every plan includes the full platform: unlimited push notifications, unlimited in-app messages, unlimited campaigns and journeys, full segmentation, A/B testing, API access, analytics, and ManyMoneyAI — our autonomous revenue copilot. There are no feature gates or 'Enterprise only' limitations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is ManyMoneyAI?
 
 
 
 
 
ManyMoneyAI is an autonomous AI copilot built into every Pushwoosh plan. It optimizes content, timing, and channels automatically — hunting for revenue 24/7. It activates in 30 minutes with no technical integration needed, and comes with a +40% revenue growth guarantee.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How does email pricing work?
 
 
 
 
 
Every MAU includes 20 email sends per month. For the Omnichannel plan with 10,000 MAU, that means 200,000 emails included. Need more? Extra sends cost $1.50 per 1,000 emails. Push notifications and in-app messages are always unlimited at no extra cost.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How much does it cost to send a WhatsApp message?
 
 
 
 
 
WhatsApp pricing depends on whether you use it as part of an Omnichannel plan or on its own.
As part of an Omnichannel plan
: If your plan includes other channels — push, in-app, email, SMS — WhatsApp is covered by your plan's MAU, calculated the same way as the rest of your channels. There's no separate WhatsApp charge from Pushwoosh.
WhatsApp only
: If WhatsApp is the only channel you use, you're billed on WhatsApp MAU. A WhatsApp MAU is a unique user you contacted at least once during the billing period. Users you don't message aren't counted, no matter how many are stored in your audience.
Meta's charges are separate
: In both cases, Pushwoosh MAU pricing covers the platform. Meta bills its own fees for messages sent through the WhatsApp Business API, charged separately to the payment card linked to your WhatsApp Business Account, in addition to your Pushwoosh plan. Rates are set by Meta and vary by message category and recipient country — see 
Meta's official pricing
 for current rates.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do I need the SDK if I only send email, SMS, or WhatsApp?
 
 
 
 
 
No. If you don't need push notifications, you can skip the SDK entirely — just import your users' emails, phone numbers, or WhatsApp numbers, manually or via API. Note that MAU billing isn't limited to push: any user who receives a message on any channel (push, email, SMS, WhatsApp, etc.) counts toward your MAU for that month, even without a push token or app/website activity. Users are deduplicated by their unique User ID, so a user who gets both an email and an SMS in the same month is still counted once.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What's the difference between Omnichannel and Email only?
 
 
 
 
 
The Omnichannel plan ($13/1K MAU) includes all channels: push notifications, in-app messages, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more. The Email only plan ($5/1K recipients) is for teams that only need email. Both plans include every platform feature, including ManyMoneyAI.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How long does it take to integrate Pushwoosh?
 
 
 
 
 
It takes 2 to 10 days to integrate the Pushwoosh SDK, import users, and start gathering push subscribers. ManyMoneyAI activates in just 30 minutes. 
Contact us
 if you need help migrating from another platform.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What happens when I reach the custom pricing threshold?
 
 
 
 
 
When your estimated cost exceeds $3,000/month, we offer a custom plan with dedicated support, SLA guarantees, and volume-based discounts. Our team will tailor the plan to your specific needs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Is Pushwoosh GDPR and ePrivacy compliant?
 
 
 
 
 
Pushwoosh is fully compliant with GDPR and ePrivacy regulations. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified, SOC 2 Type 1 audited, and HIPAA compliant. 
Learn more
 about how Pushwoosh meets the highest industry standards for data security and privacy.
